from pandas.core.dtypes.missing import array_equivalent

cases = []

right = np.array([complex(2, np.nan)], dtype='c16')
cases.append(("c16_both_nan_case1", left, right))

left = np.array([complex(np.nan, 1)], dtype='c16')
right = np.array([complex(np.nan, 2)], dtype='c16')
cases.append(("c16_both_nan_case2", left, right))

left = np.array([1 + 2j, complex(3, np.nan)], dtype='c16')
right = np.array([1 + 2j, complex(9, np.nan)], dtype='c16')
cases.append(("c16_both_nan_case3", left, right))

left = np.array([1 + 2j, complex(3, np.nan)], dtype='c16')
right = np.array([5 + 2j, complex(9, np.nan)], dtype='c16')
cases.append(("c16_diff_finite_case4", left, right))

# c8 (complex64)
left = np.array([complex(1, np.nan)], dtype='c8')
right = np.array([complex(2, np.nan)], dtype='c8')
cases.append(("c8_both_nan_case1", left, right))

left = np.array([complex(np.nan, 1)], dtype='c8')
right = np.array([complex(np.nan, 2)], dtype='c8')
cases.append(("c8_both_nan_case2", left, right))

left = np.array([1 + 2j, complex(3, np.nan)], dtype='c8')
right = np.array([1 + 2j, complex(9, np.nan)], dtype='c8')
cases.append(("c8_both_nan_case3", left, right))

# Run dtype_equal=True/False for each case and record.
for name, L, R in cases:

    probe(name + "_dtype_equal_true", v_true)
    probe(name + "_dtype_equal_false", v_false)
